propositions: No aggregated metrics lens exists for 344 closed bugs; trend analysis requires ad-hoc scripts today.
The bug_trends lens must expose five dimensions: close_class distribution by month, detected_by distribution, open-bug age percentiles, caused_by fan-in per target, and time-to-close percentiles.
Pre-convention bugs lacking close_class (circa 214 records) must surface as an explicit MISSING labeled cohort to prevent silent era mixing.

Stock dimensions (age percentiles, detected_by, caused_by fan-in) measure current store state independent of time range, while flow dimensions (close_class-by-month, time-to-close) filter on close timestamp within the ctx range window.
Sparse or absent detected_by field must degrade that dimension to unavailable without affecting other dimensions or crashing.
